messages:
viv: quick bring-up notes for cinder-9b variants. ran chat, qa, and long-summary slices. looking for a routing rec we can ship to product.

elena: please paste topline numbers.

viv: TL;DR: int5-mix (kv=int6, weights int5) gives near-int6 quality with cost close to int4. numbers below (fp16-13b baseline for reference).
- cinder-9b-int5-mix: p50=76ms, p95=178ms, synth-qa delta = -0.4pp vs fp16-13b, long-summary factuality delta = -0.6pp, throughput ~1100 tok/s, est $0.55 / 1M tokens
- cinder-9b-int6: p50=80ms, p95=185ms, synth-qa delta = -0.6pp, throughput ~980 tok/s, est $0.74 / 1M tokens
- cinder-9b-int4: p50=64ms, p95=230ms, synth-qa delta = -3.0pp, throughput ~1250 tok/s, est $0.42 / 1M tokens
- core-13b-int8 (safety): p50=136ms, p95=345ms, synth-qa delta = -0.2pp, throughput ~660 tok/s, est $1.09 / 1M tokens

drew: int5-mix KL/JS vs fp16? any distribution drift?

viv: ran JS-divergence on top-1/top-5: int5-mix JS~0.009, int4 JS~0.038. logit gap metric also looks favorable for int5-mix (median logit-gap change ~0.02).

samir: how does warmstart/kvcache behave for int5-mix vs int4?

viv: int5-mix keeps kv layers high-precision so warmstart is stable (p95 similar to int6). int4 shows notable cold-start spikes for users with >600 tokens history.

elena: routing rec? product needs a sentence and a config sketch.

viv: recommendation: default -> cinder-9b-int5-mix (70%), cheap-short -> cinder-9b-int4 (15%) for queries <=50 tokens and history <=120, safety -> core-13b-int8 (15%). Add a calibrated logit-margin hijack: if top_logit_diff < 0.9 AND predicted_factuality_score < 0.5, route to 13b. Also add an overlap-length probe: if user_history_overlap_tokens > 400, prefer int5/int6 to avoid cold-cache misses. Warm-probe cheap-short bucket at low rate (1 probe / 8k active users).

drew: blended cost?

viv: blended ~= 0.7*0.55 + 0.15*0.42 + 0.15*1.09 = ~$0.62 / 1M tokens. Expected p95 under 240ms for ~92% traffic with these rules.

samir: what's the communicated QA risk?

viv: recommended wording: "Expected QA impact ~0.3-0.8pp vs fp16-13b under proposed routing; fallback rules target low-confidence or long-history requests to protect factuality."

elena: can you sketch the route yaml for ops?

viv: quick sketch:
```
routes:
  - name: cheap-short
    model: cinder-9b-int4
    match:
      - query_tokens <= 50
      - history_tokens <= 120
    weight: 0.15
  - name: default
    model: cinder-9b-int5-mix
    weight: 0.70
  - name: safety-fallback
    model: core-13b-int8
    match: top_logit_diff < 0.9 AND predicted_factuality_score < 0.5 OR history_overlap_tokens > 400
    weight: 0.15
```

ops-bot: deploy-canary: route config queued for canary c-202509-13, 1% traffic, start=2025-09-13T12:30:00Z :rocket:

drew: monitoring checklist: per-route synth-qa delta, top_logit_diff distribution, history_overlap hit-rate, warm-probe effectiveness. rollback cheap-short if synth-qa drift >1.2pp sustained for 30m.

elena: thanks 10. please push dashboard + 4h and 12h snapshots.

viv: will do, posting canary snapshots here after 4h. :bar_chart:
